footnotes.609: Ending with the ultimate knowledge of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

ayahs.translationClear: So he began with their bags, before his brother’s bag. Then he pulled it out of his brother’s bag. Thus We devised a plan for Joseph; he could not have detained his brother under the king’s law, unless Allah so willed. We elevate by degrees whomever We will; and above every person of knowledge, there is one more learned.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ إِن يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ أَنتُمْ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ إِن يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ‌ۚ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ‌ۚ قَالَ أَنتُمْ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا‌ۖ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا اِنْ يَّسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ اَخٌ لَّهٗ مِنْ قَبْلُۚ فَاَسَرَّهَا يُوْسُفُ فِيْ نَفْسِهٖ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْۚ قَالَ اَنْتُمْ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًاۚ وَاللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them.[610] He said, "You are worse in position, and Allāh is most knowing of what you describe."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo in yasriq faqad saraqa akhul lahoo min qablu fa'asarrahaa yoosufu fee nafsihee walam yubdihaa lahum qaala antum sharrum makaanan wallaahu a'lamu bimaa tasifoon

footnotes.610: He did not answer that he himself had been stolen by them from his father.

ayahs.translationClear: They said, “If he has stolen, a brother of his has stolen before.” But Joseph kept it to himself, and did not reveal it to them. He said, “You are in a worse situation, and Allah is Aware of what you allege.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُۥٓ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُۥٓ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُۥٓ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُۥٓ‌ۖ إِنَّا نَرَىٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْعَزِيْزُ اِنَّ لَهٗٓ اَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيْرًا فَخُذْ اَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهٗۚ اِنَّا نَرٰىكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O ʿAzeez,[611] indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaa'ayyuhal-'azeezu inna lahoo aban shaykhan kabeeran fakhudh ahadanaa makaanahoo innaa naraaka minal-muhsineen

footnotes.611: Addressing Joseph, who now held the title of "al-ʿAzeez."

ayahs.translationClear: They said, “O noble prince, he has a father, a very old man, so take one of us in his place. We see that you are a good person.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ أَن نَّأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَن وَجَدْنَا مَتَـٰعَنَا عِندَهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّظَـٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ أَن نَّأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَن وَجَدْنَا مَتَـٰعَنَا عِندَهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّظَـٰلِمُونَ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللّٰهِ اَنْ نَّاْخُذَ اِلَّا مَنْ وَّجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِنْدَهٗٓۙ اِنَّا͏ٓ اِذًا لَّظٰلِمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh [to prevent] that we take except him with whom we found our possession. Indeed, we would then be unjust."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala ma'aadhallaahi an na'khudha illaa man wajadnaa mataa'anaa 'indahoo innaa idhal lazaalimoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Allah forbid that we should arrest anyone except him in whose possession we found our property; for then we would be unjust.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسُوا۟ مِنْهُ خَلَصُوا۟ نَجِيًّا ۖ قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُم مَّوْثِقًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطتُمْ فِى يُوسُفَ ۖ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ ٱلْأَرْضَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْذَنَ لِىٓ أَبِىٓ أَوْ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ لِى ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسُوا۟ مِنْهُ خَلَصُوا۟ نَجِيًّا‌ۖ قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُم مَّوْثِقًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطتُمْ فِى يُوسُفَ‌ۖ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ ٱلْأَرْضَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْذَنَ لِىٓ أَبِىٓ أَوْ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ لِى‌ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْـٔ͏َسُوْا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوْا نَجِيًّاؕ قَالَ كَبِيْرُهُمْ اَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اَبَاكُمْ قَدْ اَخَذَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَّوْثِقًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطْتُّمْ فِيْ يُوْسُفَۚ فَلَنْ اَبْرَحَ الْاَرْضَ حَتّٰي يَاْذَنَ لِيْٓ اَبِيْٓ اَوْ يَحْكُمَ اللّٰهُ لِيْۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحٰكِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. The eldest of them said, "Do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by Allāh and [that] before you failed in [your duty to] Joseph? So I will never leave [this] land until my father permits me or Allāh decides for me,[612] and He is the best of judges.
ayahs.transliteration: Falammastay'asoo minhu khalasoo najiyyan qaala kabeeruhum alam ta'lamoo anna abaakum qad akhadha 'alaykum mawthiqam minallaahi wamin qablu maa farrattum fee yoosufa falan abrahal-arda hattaa ya'dhana lee abee aw yahkumallaahu lee wahuwa khayrul-haakimeen

footnotes.612: i.e., in my favor by bringing about the release of Benjamin.

ayahs.translationClear: And when they despaired of him, they conferred privately. Their eldest said, “Don’t you know that your father received a pledge from you before Allah, and in the past you failed with regard to Joseph? I will not leave this land until my father permits me, or Allah decides for me; for He is the Best of deciders.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّ ٱبْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَآ إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَـٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّ ٱبْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَآ إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَـٰفِظِينَ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِرْجِعُوْٓا اِلٰٓي اَبِيْكُمْ فَقُوْلُوْا يٰٓاَبَانَا͏ٓ اِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَۚ وَمَا شَهِدْنَا͏ٓ اِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حٰفِظِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Return to your father and say, 'O our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not witnesses of the unseen.[613]
ayahs.transliteration: Irji'oo ilaa abeekum faqooloo yaa'abaanaa innabnaka saraqa wamaa shahidnaa illaa bimaa 'alimnaa wamaa kunnaa lilghaybi haafizeen

footnotes.613: i.e., We could not have known when we gave you the oath that he would steal and be apprehended.

ayahs.translationClear: “Go back to your father, and say, ‘Our father, your son has stolen. We testify only to what we know, and we could not have prevented the unforeseen.’”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنَّا فِيهَا وَٱلْعِيرَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا ۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنَّا فِيهَا وَٱلْعِيرَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا‌ۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَسْـٔ͏َلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِيْ كُنَّا فِيْهَا وَالْعِيْرَ الَّتِيْٓ اَقْبَلْنَا فِيْهَاؕ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful.'"
ayahs.transliteration: Was'alil-qaryatal-latee kunnaa feehaa wal-'eeral-latee aqbalnaa feehaa wa'innaa lasaadiqoon
ayahs.translationClear: “Ask the town where we were, and the caravan in which we came. We are being truthful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا‌ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ‌ۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ اَنْفُسُكُمْ اَمْرًاؕ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيْلٌؕ عَسَي اللّٰهُ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَنِيْ بِهِمْ جَمِيْعًاؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَلِيْمُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allāh will bring them to me all together. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun 'asallaahu an ya'tiyanee bihim jamee'an innahoo huwal-'aleemul-hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Rather, your souls have contrived something for you. Patience is a virtue. Perhaps Allah will bring them all back to me. He is the Knowing, the Wise.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَوَلّٰي عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يٰٓاَسَفٰي عَلٰي يُوْسُفَ وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنٰهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white[614] from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.[615]
ayahs.transliteration: Watawallaa 'anhum waqaala yaa'asafaa 'alaa yoosufa wabyaddat 'aynaahu minal-huzni fahuwa kazeem

footnotes.615: He did not express the extent of his grief or his anger at what he suspected his sons had done but was patient, depending only upon Allāh for help.

ayahs.translationClear: Then he turned away from them, and said, “O my bitterness for Joseph.” And his eyes turned white from sorrow, and he became depressed.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا۟ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْهَـٰلِكِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا۟ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْهَـٰلِكِينَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا تَاللّٰهِ تَفْتَو͏ٔ͏ُا تَذْكُرُ يُوْسُفَ حَتّٰي تَكُوْنَ حَرَضًا اَوْ تَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْهٰلِكِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "By Allāh, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo tallaahi tafta'u tadhkuru yoosufa hattaa takoona haradan aw takoona minal-haalikeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “By Allah, you will not stop remembering Joseph, until you have ruined your health, or you have passed away.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اَشْكُوْا بَثِّيْ وَحُزْنِيْٓ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَاَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala innamaa ashkoo baththee wahuznee ilallaahi wa'a'lamu minallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.”

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰبَنِىَّ ٱذْهَبُوا۟ فَتَحَسَّسُوا۟ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَا۟يْـَٔسُ مِن رَّوْحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰبَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوْا فَتَحَسَّسُوْا مِنْ يُّوْسُفَ وَاَخِيْهِ وَلَا تَايْـٔ͏َسُوْا مِنْ رَّوْحِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يَايْـٔ͏َسُ مِنْ رَّوْحِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."
ayahs.transliteration: Yaabaniyyadhhaboo fatahassasoo min yoosufa wa'akheehi walaa tay'asoo mir rawhillaahi innahoo laa yay'asu mir rawhillaahi illal-qawmul-kaafiroon
ayahs.translationClear: “O my sons, go and inquire about Joseph and his brother, and do not despair of Allah’s comfort. None despairs of Allah’s comfort except the disbelieving people.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا ٱلضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَـٰعَةٍ مُّزْجَىٰةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا ٱلْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجْزِى ٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا ٱلضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَـٰعَةٍ مُّزْجَىٰةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا ٱلْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَآ‌ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَجْزِى ٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوْا يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْعَزِيْزُ مَسَّنَا وَاَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُّزْجٰىةٍ فَاَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So when they entered upon him [i.e., Joseph], they said, "O ʿAzeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allāh rewards the charitable."
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa dakhaloo 'alayhi qaaloo yaa'ayyuhal-'azeezu massanaa wa'ahlanad-durru waji'naa bibidaa'atim muzjaatin fa'awfi lanal-kayla watasaddaq 'alaynaa innallaaha yajzil-mutasaddiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: Then, when they entered into his presence, they said, “Mighty governor, adversity has befallen us, and our family. We have brought scant merchandise. But give us full measure, and be charitable towards us—Allah rewards the charitable.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَـٰهِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَـٰهِلُونَ ۝٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُمْ مَّا فَعَلْتُمْ بِيُوْسُفَ وَاَخِيْهِ اِذْ اَنْتُمْ جٰهِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala hal 'alimtum maa fa'altum biyoosufa wa'akheehi idh antum jaahiloon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Do you realize what you did with Joseph and his brother, in your ignorance?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ يُوسُفُ وَهَـٰذَآ أَخِى ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُ‌ۖ قَالَ أَنَا۠ يُوسُفُ وَهَـٰذَآ أَخِى‌ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَآ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ۝٩٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا ءَاِنَّكَ لَاَنْتَ يُوْسُفُؕ قَالَ اَنَا يُوْسُفُ وَهٰذَا͏ٓ اَخِيْؗ قَدْ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ مَنْ يَّتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيْعُ اَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said, "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allāh has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allāh and is patient, then indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo a'innaka la'anta yoosufu qaala ana yoosufu wahaadhaa akhee qad mannallaahu 'alaynaa innahoo man yattaqi wayasbir fa'innallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-muhsineen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Is that you, Joseph?” He said, “I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allah has been gracious to us. He who practices piety and patience—Allah never fails to reward the righteous.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ ۝٩١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدْ اٰثَرَكَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْنَا وَاِنْ كُنَّا لَخٰطِـِٕيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo tallaahi laqad aatharakallaahu 'alaynaa wa'in kunnaa lakhaati'een
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “By Allah, Allah has preferred you over us. We were definitely in the wrong.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ‌ۖ يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ‌ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ۝٩٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيْبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَؕ يَغْفِرُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمْؗ وَهُوَ اَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allāh forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala laa tathreeba 'alaykumul-yawma yaghfirullaahu lakum wahuwa arhamur-raahimeen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “There is no blame upon you today. Allah will forgive you. He is the Most Merciful of the merciful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱذْهَبُوا۟ بِقَمِيصِى هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ أَبِى يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِى بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱذْهَبُوا۟ بِقَمِيصِى هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ أَبِى يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِى بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٩٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْهَبُوْا بِقَمِيْصِيْ هٰذَا فَاَلْقُوْهُ عَلٰي وَجْهِ اَبِيْ يَاْتِ بَصِيْرًاۚ وَاْتُوْنِيْ بِاَهْلِكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together."
ayahs.transliteration: Idhhaboo biqameesee haadhaa fa'alqoohu 'alaa wajhi abee ya'ti baseeran wa'toonee bi'ahlikum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: “Take this shirt of mine, and lay it over my father’s face, and he will recover his sight. And bring your whole family to me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ‌ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ ۝٩٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيْرُ قَالَ اَبُوْهُمْ اِنِّيْ لَاَجِدُ رِيْحَ يُوْسُفَ لَوْلَا͏ٓ اَنْ تُفَنِّدُوْنِ

words.translation: you think me weakened in mind

ayahs.translation: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said,[616] "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind."
ayahs.transliteration: Walammaa fasalatil-'eeru qaala aboohum innee la'ajidu reeha yoosufa lawlaa an tufannidoon

footnotes.616: To those present with him, either some of his sons or other relatives.

ayahs.translationClear: As the caravan set out, their father said, “I sense the presence of Joseph, though you may think I am senile.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلِكَ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلِكَ ٱلْقَدِيمِ ۝٩٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا تَاللّٰهِ اِنَّكَ لَفِيْ ضَلٰلِكَ الْقَدِيْمِ
ayahs.translation: They said, "By Allāh, indeed you are in your [same] old error."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo tallaahi innaka lafee dalaalikal-qadeem
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “By Allah, you are still in your old confusion.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا‌ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٩٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا͏ٓ اَنْ جَا࢜ءَ الْبَشِيْرُ اَلْقٰىهُ عَلٰي وَجْهِهٖ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيْرًاۚ قَالَ اَلَمْ اَقُلْ لَّكُمْۚۙ اِنِّيْٓ اَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when the bearer of good tidings[617] arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?"
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa an jaa'al-basheeru alqaahu 'alaa wajhihee fartadda baseeran qaala alam aqul lakum innee a'lamu minallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon

footnotes.617: He who carried Joseph's shirt from among the brothers.

ayahs.translationClear: Then, when the bearer of good news arrived, he laid it over his face, and he regained his sight. He said, “Did I not say to you that I know from Allah what you do not know?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا ٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا خَـٰطِـِٔينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَبَانَا ٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا خَـٰطِـِٔينَ ۝٩٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا يٰٓاَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا͏ٓ اِنَّا كُنَّا خٰطِـِٕيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaa'abaanastaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa innaa kunnaa khaati'een
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Father, pray for the forgiveness of our sins; we were indeed at fault.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّىٓ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٩٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ سَوْفَ اَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّيْؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbee innahoo huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I will ask my Lord to forgive you. He is the Forgiver, the Most Merciful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مِصْرَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ ءَاوَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مِصْرَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ ۝٩٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْا عَلٰي يُوْسُفَ اٰوٰٓي اِلَيْهِ اَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوْا مِصْرَ اِنْ شَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُ اٰمِنِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself [i.e., embraced them] and said, "Enter Egypt, Allāh willing, safe [and secure]."
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa dakhaloo 'alaa yoosufa aawaa ilayhi abawayhi waqaaladkhuloo misra in shaa'allaahu aamineen
ayahs.translationClear: Then, when they entered into the presence of Joseph, he embraced his parents, and said, “Enter Egypt, Allah willing, safe and secure.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا۟ لَهُۥ سُجَّدًا ۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ هَـٰذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَـٰىَ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّى حَقًّا ۖ وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِىٓ إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِى مِنَ ٱلسِّجْنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْبَدْوِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن نَّزَغَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا۟ لَهُۥ سُجَّدًا‌ۖ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ هَـٰذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَـٰىَ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّى حَقًّا‌ۖ وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِىٓ إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِى مِنَ ٱلسِّجْنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْبَدْوِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن نَّزَغَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِىٓ‌ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَآءُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝١٠٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَرَفَعَ اَبَوَيْهِ عَلَي الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوْا لَهٗ سُجَّدًاۚ وَقَالَ يٰٓاَبَتِ هٰذَا تَاْوِيْلُ رُءْيَايَ مِنْ قَبْلُؗ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّيْ حَقًّاؕ وَقَدْ اَحْسَنَ بِيْٓ اِذْ اَخْرَجَنِيْ مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَا࢜ءَ بِكُمْ مِّنَ الْبَدْوِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اَنْ نَّزَغَ الشَّيْطٰنُ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ اِخْوَتِيْؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيْ لَطِيْفٌ لِّمَا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْعَلِيْمُ الْحَكِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration.[618] And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle[619] in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Warafa'a abawayhi 'alal-'arshi wakharroo lahoo sujjadan waqaala yaa'abati haadhaa ta'weelu ru'yaaya min qablu qad ja'alahaa rabbee haqqan waqad ahsana bee idh akhrajanee minas-sijni wajaa'a bikum minal-badwi mim ba'di an nazaghash-shaytaanu baynee wabayna ikhwatee inna rabbee lateeful limaa yashaa'u innahoo huwal-'aleemul-hakeem

footnotes.618: That of greeting and respect, which was lawful until the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ). Prostration to any person or object other than Allāh was then prohibited conclusively.
footnotes.619: Perceptive of unapparent matters within which is benefit to His servants.

ayahs.translationClear: And he elevated his parents on the throne, and they fell prostrate before him. He said, “Father, this is the fulfillment of my vision of long ago. My Lord has made it come true. He has blessed me, when He released me from prison, and brought you out of the wilderness, after the devil had sown conflict between me and my brothers. My Lord is Most Kind towards whomever He wills. He is the All-Knowing, the Most Wise.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِى مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ‌ۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِىِّۦ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ‌ۖ تَوَفَّنِى مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝١٠١
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبِّ قَدْ اٰتَيْتَنِيْ مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِيْ مِنْ تَاْوِيْلِ الْاَحَادِيْثِۚ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِࣞ اَنْتَ وَلِيّٖ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِۚ تَوَفَّنِيْ مُسْلِمًا وَّاَلْحِقْنِيْ بِالصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbi qad aataytanee minal-mulki wa'allamtanee min ta'weelil-ahaadeethi faatiras-samaawaati wal-ardi anta waliyyee fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati tawaffanee musliman wa'alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
ayahs.translationClear: “My Lord, You have given me some authority, and taught me some interpretation of events. Initiator of the heavens and the earth; You are my Protector in this life and in the Hereafter. Receive my soul in submission, and unite me with the righteous.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ‌ۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ ۝١٠٢
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ مِنْ اَنۢ͏ْبَا࢜ءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوْحِيْهِ اِلَيْكَۚ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ اِذْ اَجْمَعُوْٓا اَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muḥammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika min ambaa'il-ghaybi nooheehi ilayka wamaa kunta ladayhim idh ajma'oo amrahum wahum yamkuroon
ayahs.translationClear: This is news from the past that We reveal to you. You were not present with them when they plotted and agreed on a plan.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٠٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa aktharun-naasi walaw harasta bimu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: But most people, for all your eagerness, are not believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ‌ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٠٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا تَسْـٔ͏َلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍؕ اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa tas'aluhum 'alayhi min ajrin in huwa illaa dhikrul lil'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: You ask them no wage for it. It is only a reminder for all mankind.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَأَيِّن مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَأَيِّن مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ ۝١٠٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَاَيِّنْ مِّنْ اٰيَةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ يَمُرُّوْنَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: Waka'ayyim min aayatin fis-samaawaati wal-ardi yamurroona 'alayhaa wahum 'anhaa mu'ridoon
ayahs.translationClear: How many a sign in the heavens and the earth do they pass by, paying no attention to them?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ ۝١٠٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ اَكْثَرُهُمْ بِاللّٰهِ اِلَّا وَهُمْ مُّشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa yu'minu aktharuhum billaahi illaa wahum mushrikoon
ayahs.translationClear: And most of them do not believe in Allah unless they associate others.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَأَمِنُوٓا۟ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَـٰشِيَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَأَمِنُوٓا۟ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَـٰشِيَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ۝١٠٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَاَمِنُوْٓا اَنْ تَاْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ اللّٰهِ اَوْ تَاْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَّهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allāh or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?
ayahs.transliteration: Afa'aminoo an ta'tiyahum ghaashiyatum min 'adhaabillaahi aw ta'tiyahumus-saa'atu baghtatan wahum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.translationClear: Do they feel secure that a covering of Allah’s punishment will not come upon them, or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware?

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ هَـٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِىٓ أَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِى ۖ وَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ هَـٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِىٓ أَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِى‌ۖ وَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ۝١٠٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ هٰذِهٖ سَبِيْلِيْٓ اَدْعُوْٓا اِلَي اللّٰهِࣞؔ عَلٰي بَصِيْرَةٍ اَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِيْؕ وَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allāh with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allāh; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul haadhihee sabeelee ad'oo ilallaahi 'alaa baseeratin ana wamanittaba'anee wasubhaanallaahi wamaa ana minal-mushrikeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “This is my way; I invite to Allah, based on clear knowledge—I and whoever follows me. Glory be to Allah; and I am not of the polytheists.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۗ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ‌ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ‌ۗ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟‌ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ ۝١٠٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوْحِيْٓ اِلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْقُرٰيؕ اَفَلَمْ يَسِيْرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْاؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they[620] not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh; then will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim min ahlil-quraa afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim waladaarul-aakhirati khayrul lilladheenattaqaw afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: We did not send before you except men, whom We inspired, from the people of the towns. Have they not roamed the earth and seen the consequences for those before them? The Home of the Hereafter is better for those who are righteous. Do you not understand?

ayahs.textUthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسَ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا۟ جَآءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّىَ مَن نَّشَآءُ ۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ٱسْتَيْـَٔسَ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا۟ جَآءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّىَ مَن نَّشَآءُ‌ۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۝١١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: حَتّٰٓي اِذَا اسْتَيْـٔ͏َسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوْٓا اَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوْا جَا࢜ءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَاۙ فَنُجِّيَ مَنْ نَّشَا࢜ءُؕ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَاْسُنَا عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.
ayahs.transliteration: Hattaa idhastay'asar-rusulu wazannoo annahum qad kudhiboo jaa'ahum nasrunaa fanujjiya man nashaa'u walaa yuraddu ba'sunaa 'anil-qawmil-mujrimeen
ayahs.translationClear: Until, when the messengers have despaired, and thought that they were rejected, Our help came to them. We save whomever We will, and Our severity is not averted from the guilty people.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِى قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِى قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ‌ۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝١١١
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِيْ قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّاُولِي الْاَلْبَابِؕ مَا كَانَ حَدِيْثًا يُّفْتَرٰي وَلٰكِنْ تَصْدِيْقَ الَّذِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيْلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّهُدًي وَّرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad kaana fee qasasihim 'ibratul li'ulil-albaabi maa kaana hadeethan yuftaraa walaakin tasdeeqal-ladhee bayna yadayhi watafseela kulli shay'in wahudan warahmatal liqawmin yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: In their stories is a lesson for those who possess intelligence. This is not a fabricated tale, but a confirmation of what came before it, and a detailed explanation of all things, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe.
